---
title: "Other agents"
---

The exercises use OpenCode. You may compare another agent if it is already available. This page was checked 2026-09-12, so verify commands in the current vendor documentation.

## Optional comparisons

**Antigravity.** Check its project rules, sandbox, and telemetry settings in the [official documentation](https://antigravity.google/). Turning off telemetry does not make research data safe to share.

The [Antigravity setup recording](../media/videos/agy-setup.mp4) may show older screens.

**Codex.** Use the [Codex setup and sandboxing guides](https://developers.openai.com/codex/). Check the account's current data controls before using anything beyond toy data.

**Claude Code.** Use [Claude's installation and memory documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory). Claude reads `CLAUDE.md` according to its own precedence rules. This file does not create an operating-system security boundary.

Launch an installed agent from the lab directory with `agy` (Antigravity), `codex` (Codex), or `claude` (Claude Code). Authenticate only through its documented flow.

::: {.callout-warning}
Approval bypass and sandbox settings are separate controls. Antigravity's `--dangerously-skip-permissions` approves all tool calls and differs from `--sandbox`. Codex's `--ask-for-approval never` differs from `--sandbox danger-full-access`. Claude's `--dangerously-skip-permissions` is a permission mode, not a sandbox. Verify current help, and never use these bypass modes on your laptop or with real data.
:::

For every agent, check the working directory, loaded instructions, permissions, and changed files. If it does not run in the Codespace, inspect its documentation or interface and continue with OpenCode.
